title: Himachal Pradesh Mukhyamantri Sahayaata Kosh / Himcare Policy Document

nodes.title: 1. Overview & Objectives
nodes.content: Himachal Pradesh government health protection programme(s) supporting eligible residents with hospitalization coverage under current state rules.

nodes.title: 2. Eligibility Criteria
nodes.content: Eligibility depends on the current Himachal Pradesh scheme, beneficiary category and enrolment rules; verify whether the applicant is covered under HIMCARE or another state/PM-JAY pathway.

nodes.title: 3. Benefits & Coverage
nodes.content: Financial assistance and healthcare benefits provided under Himachal Pradesh Mukhyamantri Sahayaata Kosh / Himcare.

nodes.title: 4. Required Documents & Application Process
nodes.content: Aadhaar Card, Income Certificate, Ration Card, and Bank Account details.
